description: The crossing fixture of factory graph 2 (asymmetric-bets), read by AT11 and t276 of tests/factory-graph-2.test.mjs and by AT18 of packages/runner/test/dispatch/render-skill-instructions.test.ts. It is deliberately not a thesis: the values are the smallest ones that still validate against both contracts of every node, so what the fixture proves is that the six contracts fit into one another and that `decide` refuses an outcome with no recorded human answer — never that any thesis is any good. The frame keys below (`crossing`, `node`, `input`, `output`) belong to this file alone. The keys inside the payloads belong to the manifests, and `perguntas_respondidas` / `pergunta` / `resposta` are the control plane's own projection vocabulary, which is why they are the only Portuguese left here.
